pushDescription: Get notified when an agent you can access finishes a response or needs your attention. Enable each device separately. Conversation content is not shown on the lock screen. Clicking opens the conversation; notifications never approve an action.
pushAvailability: On iPhone/iPad (iOS 16.4 or later), first add Mergeron to your Home Screen and open that app. On PC/Mac/Android, use a compatible browser. Internet access and notification permission are required; system settings and Focus mode may delay or hide alerts.
pushPersonalAccountRequired: Sign in with your active personal account, outside impersonation mode, to manage notifications.
pushUnsupported: Notifications are unavailable here. Open the installed app or a compatible browser over HTTPS.
pushPermissionDenied: Notifications are not allowed. Check Mergeron permissions in your browser or device settings, then reopen this panel.
pushNotConfigured: The server is not ready for notifications. An administrator must check the public URL, private keys and Push network access.
pushFailed: The operation failed. Check connectivity, permissions and server network configuration, then try again.
pushDeviceAlreadyLinked: This browser is already linked to another account. Disable notifications on this device before enabling them for your account.
pushWorkerUnavailable: The app notification service is not ready. Reopen Mergeron after its update, then try again.
pushLocalStorageUnavailable: Local storage is blocked. Allow it to remember this device without storing conversation content.
pushDeviceLimit: The 20-device limit was reached. Remove an old device before adding another.
pushInvalidDevice: Enter a device name between 1 and 80 characters.
pushDevicePlaceholder: E.g. personal iPhone or office Mac
pushThisDeviceEnabled: Notifications are enabled on this device.
pushTestPending: Last test: waiting to send (network failures are retried automatically).
pushTestSent: Last test: accepted by the Push service. Display depends on your device settings.
pushTestDropped: Last test: not sent. Check permissions and server Push network access.
reloadHelp: Reload the app to get the deployed version. Unsaved input may be lost.
description: Open Mergeron in its own window. A server connection is still required; conversations and documents are not stored for offline use.
manualIntroduction: If the browser does not offer its installation prompt, use its menu.
edge: In Edge: open the ⋯ menu, then Apps (or More tools → Apps), then Install this site as an app. An installation icon may also appear in the address bar.
safari: In Safari on Mac: File → Add to Dock. On iPhone/iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen, depending on the browser and system version.
availability: Sign in to Mergeron first. The browser determines installation availability: private browsing, enterprise policy, an existing installation or a recent dismissal may prevent the prompt. Installation never starts automatically.
